findings.claim: The spec authorizes changing the `no-hardcoded-secrets` constraint to scan `docker/` Markdown even though the project constraints explicitly define the current scan scope as excluding Markdown.
findings.evidence: constraints.md says `no-hardcoded-secrets` has check: `git grep --no-index --exclude-standard -n -E -e "--(user|pass)=" -e "sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}" -- "docker/*" "*.mjs" "*.json" "*.toml" "*.yaml" "*.yml"` and note: `Markdown is excluded on purpose: the docs quote the source pack''s root/root as the thing not to do.` The spec instead says: `Replace the no-hardcoded-secrets git-grep content check with a Node checker ... same scan boundary (including docker/ Markdown)` and `Original scan boundary is preserved ... explicitly including docker/ Markdown`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either keep Markdown out of the Node checker to preserve the actual approved scan boundary, or obtain and cite explicit operator/rule-owner authorization to expand the boundary to Markdown before specifying it.

findings.claim: Task 6.3 requires running every structural constraint even though one blocking structural constraint has no portable check and is manual-only, making the acceptance ambiguous and not directly executable.
findings.evidence: constraints.md defines `no-symlinks` with note: `No portable one-line check exists without a forbidden tool. Manual until scripts/doctor.mjs lands ...`. The tasks require: `Run the required gates once at the completed boundary: ... and every structural constraint including the Node secret checker and the whole-descendant link inventory` without specifying how manual-only constraints like `no-symlinks`, `exactly-two-services`, and `reference-repo-untouched` are evidenced.
findings.suggested_fix: Spell out which structural constraints are command-checked versus manually reviewed, and define required receipts for each manual constraint.

findings.claim: The dependency clean-install task omits the exact cross-platform npm command and flags needed to satisfy the no-symlinks goal.
findings.evidence: The goal says: `Close the literal no-symlinks verification gap without silently weakening constraints or deleting dependencies.` The task only says: `Run the locked clean install with executable links and lifecycle scripts disabled in this isolated worktree only`, while constraints require commands to be cross-shell and avoid ambiguous shell behavior; no exact `npm ci` invocation, env handling, or config scope is specified.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify the exact npm command(s) and config mechanism, e.g. local project-scoped npm config or command flags, and include verification that no global/user npm config changed.

findings.claim: The plan says all production edits finish before any gate runs, but individual tasks require targeted tests/checks before later production work and before group 6.
findings.evidence: design.md states: `All production edits (groups 1–5 of tasks.md) complete before any gate runs. Then, at the completed child boundary...`. tasks.md earlier requires checks inside production groups, e.g. `1.2 ... verify skills/carried-payload.test.mjs passes`, `2.1 ... verify lib/platform/paths.test.mjs still passes`, and `2.2 ... verify the no-home-or-tmp-literals check reports zero matches`.
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish pre-boundary targeted developer probes from final gates, or move these verifications into group 6 if the no-gates-before-completion rule is strict.

findings.claim: The adaptation provenance task requires final hashes before the payload regeneration task that produces the final payloads.
findings.evidence: Task 1.3 says: `Add a dated mini adaptation record ... naming ... final actual hashes ... verify ... the final hashes are filled in after group 6 regeneration`, while task 6.1 later says: `regenerate both harness distributions from the finished source`.
findings.suggested_fix: Split the provenance record into an initial draft and a post-regeneration update, or move final hash completion after task 6.1.

findings.claim: The spec relies on Analyze adjudication receipts for the finite secret disposition store, but the packet only lists Analyze outputs and does not include the receipts or their exact paths.
findings.evidence: design.md says dispositions are `derived from the Analyze receipts` and tasks.md says `from the Analyze adjudication receipts`; prior_handoffs list Analyze outputs only as `analysis.md`, `library-candidates.json`, `decision-log.md`, `evidence/analyze/review-summary.json`, and `evidence/analyze/candidate-validation-02.json`, with no named adjudication receipt paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the exact adjudication receipt files and required fields/digests, or add a task to produce/validate the disposition source before implementing the checker.
